name: Self-scheduled wake
summary: The agent itself decides when it should run next, using a scheduling tool to create, move or cancel its own future wake-ups ("check back on this PR in 2 hours"). Timing follows the task instead of a fixed interval.
how: Give the agent a tool to create, edit and cancel scheduled jobs
During a run, the agent schedules a follow-up with a time and a prompt
The scheduler wakes the agent at that time with the saved context
The agent finishes, or schedules another wake
facts: Efficient timing, but the agent can over- or under-schedule itself
watchOut: Needs limits so the agent can't schedule runaway loops
Hard to audit why a wake was set
